remediationsCovered.Phase_2_Hold_Durability: Procedure suite slot hold durability implemented with atomic database conditional acquisition (updateMany status=AVAILABLE) and release. Substring-proof exact JSON hold parsing. Concurrency-tested with 20 parallel sessions: exactly 1 winner and 19 409 Conflict.
remediationsCovered.Phase_3_Discount_RBAC: Discount approval supervisor authorization strictly scoped by staff facility assignments. Attending physician self-approval blocked, out-of-facility approval rejected with 403 Forbidden, 30% platform ceiling enforced across all pricing workflows.
remediationsCovered.Phase_4_Check_In_Integrity: Day-of-procedure check-in notes structured serialization preserved across regex updates with robust JSON brace extraction. Delimiter header injection stripped. Intake vitals range validation (HR 20-300 bpm, SpO2 50-100%, Temp 30-45C). GET /appointments/:id/check-in access strictly scoped to patient owner, assigned doctor, and clinical staff.
remediationsCovered.Phase_5_Prisma_Dependency: Deterministic deployment strategy verified: npm ci on server installs pinned local prisma binary, eliminating unpinned dynamic npx downloads.
remediationsCovered.Phase_6_Readiness_Checklist: Pre-op Day -1 readiness checklist aligned with authoritative Postman collection and Doctor Web frontend contract.
remediationsCovered.Phase_7_OCR_Format_Validation: Multi-format validation strictly enforcing 8 supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, TIFF, TIF, BMP, WEBP, and PDF. Full audit of all 26 OCR endpoints across the CareID ecosystem documented with Mermaid sequence diagrams.
remediationsCovered.Phase_8_Patient_Status_Fallback: Patient profile status fallback in admin repository corrected from default ACTIVE fabrication to true profile status or UNKNOWN.
